principles: runtime telemetry must not participate in semantic story merges
real source and story metadata conflicts must remain visible
legacy and new activity paths must behave consistently
drivers: Prodenovo reports .koala/activity.jsonl as the only remaining DONE merge conflict
existing helper only treats docs/story/activity.jsonl as volatile
DONE merge path already has a pre-commit cleanup hook for legacy activity

options.name: A: reset runtime activity paths before story branch DONE commit
pros: keeps merge strategy narrow and deterministic
cons: requires careful handling when activity path is tracked in one branch but not the other

options.name: B: use merge -X theirs globally
cons: can mask legitimate conflicts outside runtime logs
strategy direction is easy to misunderstand in main merge context

options.name: C: allow conflict then auto-resolve activity files after merge
pros: keeps branch contents untouched until merge
cons: requires operating inside conflicted main state
harder to rollback cleanly if another conflict appears

chosen: A: reset runtime activity paths before story branch DONE commit
rationale: 选择 A，因为它只影响 runtime activity 路径，并在 merge 前消除冲突源，不会扩大到代码或 story metadata。

preMortem.scenario: activity path exists only on story branch
preMortem.trigger: older project tracks .koala/activity.jsonl after story commands
preMortem.consequence: merge sees delete/modify or add conflict
preMortem.mitigation: cleanup helper falls back to git rm --cached --ignore-unmatch when main has no path

preMortem.scenario: real code conflict is accidentally hidden
preMortem.consequence: DONE merge reports success while source conflict was swallowed
preMortem.mitigation: isDoneVolatilePath only accepts exact .koala/activity.jsonl and docs/story/activity.jsonl

preMortem.trigger: not all repos migrated to .koala runtime log
preMortem.mitigation: helper handles both runtime and legacy paths in one fixed list
